name: keyquorum-relay-worker
description: Cloudflare Worker for the KeyQuorum relay. Stage 2 ships a health-only stub so the deployment check can be proven before the relay exists.

scripts.guard: node scripts/guard.mjs wrangler.toml --allow-preview-urls && node scripts/guard.mjs admin/wrangler.toml && node scripts/guard.mjs spike/wrangler.toml
scripts.build: wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist --env="" && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/staging --env staging && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/admin --env="" -c admin/wrangler.toml && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/admin-staging --env staging -c admin/wrangler.toml
